tasks.goal: Background VerificationTask v0: add src/verification/task-types.ts (VerificationTask status machine including lost; output uri/offset; deliveredAt latch; ownerIdentity via RuntimeProcessIdentity). Add src/verification/task-store.ts for atomic JSON under .cliyard/verification/<id>.json (save/load/list). Add src/verification/task-runner.ts to start a detached finite command process group in a caller-supplied worktree cwd bound to artifactCommit, append output, advance offset, persist identity, set succeeded/failed/canceled. Add src/verification/task-recovery.ts recoverVerificationTasks(repoRoot) that marks running/stopping without live matching identity as lost (never succeeded by inference). Export from src/verification/index.ts (or existing barrel). Add tests/verification-task.test.ts covering offset advance, idempotent deliveredAt, parent-exit survival of verify child, recovery orphan→lost. Evidence docs/evidence/VERIFICATION_TASK_V0.md + CURRENT_STATE/ROADMAP.
